propositions: A single project's base-query transport failure (400, 401/403, 404, 429, 5xx, timeout) currently aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects instead of failing open per-project.
The per-project try/except boundary does not exist in the base-query loop unlike the enrichment loop, causing one bad project to block all others.
One bad project's partial or failed query results can leak into the shared snapshot, causing false deletion signals in the differ if the merge is not atomic.
A syntactically-invalid or unmapped project key must still fail the entire pass closed (existing behavior), distinct from transport-level failures.
Per-project base-query fetch failures must emit an observable alert (fetcher-project-fetch-failed) naming the project and pass_id for observability.
Stalled pagination errors (BackendPaginationStallError) must re-raise to signal a truncated read, not be silently suppressed.
